finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The PDO selection is attacker-controlled and the registerAddress is used to construct an I2C register object that could potentially be used to execute commands.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked that the switch statement (lines 5–24) exhaustively maps each enum value of HUSB238_PDOSelection to a compile‑time constant register address (HUSB238_SRC_PDO_5V, …). No user‑supplied string or shell command is constructed. The Adafruit_I2CRegister constructor on line 29 receives a numeric address, and the Adafruit_I2CRegisterBit constructor on line 32 only receives a register reference and bit index; neither involves command execution. Thus there is no path from the attacker‑controlled pd to an OS command execution, invalidating the OS Command Injection claim.
